notes.title: Patch 1.2.1.0: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixes a bug where in the first Ongess battle if Cosette was in your party and you're on the bad ending route, the story dialogue could get caught in a loop until you manually restart the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a potential crash in Battle of Far Port upon victory. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.9: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game! [/b][/p][list][*][p]Contains a hot fix for a bad ending requirement. [spoiler]The Bad end previously would not trigger if you decide to go to Ryuvia, sink every ship except for Arcadius, then capture Arcadius' ship last.[/spoiler] [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.8: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Qisah would run off screen in RPG battles after using the special Smash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur due to a story forced retreat in RPG battles where Icari was in the middle of using Remeiken.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a theoretical crash that could occur if a unit is killed in a RPG battle at the same time a buff is being applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0.7: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]For users with old GPUs struggling with low FPS, try holding down the letters W, A, T, E, R and the CTRL key at the same time in the battles to turn off the water. [b]This is not recommended if you are above the minimum system requirements found on the store page[/b].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The bounty gain of Divine Prayer is now 2.5x rather than 5x.[/p][/*][*][p]The self-fleet wide damage of Divine Prayer has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where voiced lines play the wrong voices if you save and load on the first line of the scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which would cause the UI from choices to overlay on top of the Party Status Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Counter passive not working in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that resulted in Kryska's Guard special not working in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would cause enemies to follow Kryska off screen while she retreats under the effects of Taunt in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would result in the Fire Proof Sails effect from your own ships getting applied to the enemy rather than youself.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would lead to Lynn's sprite looping the animation for throwing a shuriken in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that would occur if you try and proceed past the final scene screen without selecting a girl.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.2.0.6: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the armor of Arcadius in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]The Bitter Conclusion will now always end by turn 26, with additional units now spawning up until this point.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where captured ships would then allow you to capture other ships with only one crew member.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where more reinforcements could be spawned through the use of saves in the Ambush at Ongess mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would allow you to capture a Fort.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player would be unable to rebind the quick load key without triggering a quick load.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where text offset would always reset upon starting the game up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would lead story forced retreats registering as a proper defeats.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by having all active ships in your fleet obstructed when it comes to line of sight (relevant to missions like the Liberation of Ryuvia).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by trying to load a quick save that does not exist.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.2.0.5: Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]WARNING: Save files made in this version cannot be loaded into older versions of the game![/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced enemy attack damage in RPG battles for Normal difficulty and lower. Higher difficulties remain unchanged.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the base evasion of the PACT Elite Samurai in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the order Sea Goddess couldn't be issued with the controller input scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player is able to keep Cosette after Sargasso despite her removal from the party.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Cosette can be recruited outside of her flag requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player could postpone certain discussions with Asaga, Chigara and Maray to create a soft lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash in RPG battles where Icari tries to trigger a multi-hit on an enemy that was killed in the same animation frame.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additionally as of 04/08/2025![/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the base evasion of Icari in RPG battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the evasion granted by the order All Guard.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Wishall so that upon use it will also end the enemy's turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Added gameplay tips to the loading screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added to the bakery that foods generated by it will remain in the player's inventory at zero count - you will still see them even when you don't have any to equip.[/p][p][i]Please note that this only applies to foods created in this build or later, anything made in prior game builds will not get the zero count.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]A previously inaccessible recipe for the bakery can now be made again, the Cream Puff.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the pause menu would close on its own when using a controller on the ship map.[/p][/*][/list]
